## Problem

What repeated user code, correctness hazard, or operator pain does this address?

## Current Workaround

How do you solve it today using the public API?

## Proposed Shape

What should RPA Core provide?

## Compatibility

Would this affect public APIs, CLI behavior, config, storage, exports, generated
projects, or examples?

## Non-Goals

What should this not do?
